pages.title: §5Boss Trial Spawner
pages.text: The Boss Trial Spawner is a key-activated spawner that summons a single boss-level enemy.

pages.title: §5Boss Trial Activation
pages.text: The key required to activate the trial can be found inside the Uncommon Sigil Forge Vault.

pages.title: §5Sigil Forge Boss Key
pages.text: A key used to activate the Boss Trial.
